verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state a mechanism to 'build custom integrations that appear and operate inside the Productboard UI' (docs-7), but the evidence pack gives no further detail on the SDK, UI extension points, deployment model, or examples of third-party integrations actually embedded in the interface. Missing for 10: concrete UI-extension API reference/SDK docs, example embedded integrations, independent/hands-on confirmation that integrations render inside the Productboard UI.
